entries.note: Scenario 8 now names the verified ratchet pin shape and verified commits; fixed in 12ebaa10.
Tag lookup gh call now has a 30s timeout and fails closed on TimeoutExpired, with a test; fixed in 12ebaa10.
Claimed Dependabot may not rewrite the ratchet tag comment. Refuted live: the verifier returned True on Dependabot's own diffs for PRs 485, 518, 603, 627 and 519.
Both git diff calls in actions_pin_bump_verified now time out after 60s and fail closed on TimeoutExpired or OSError, with tests.
Informational process note. The R15 extension was the owner's decision in this PR and is disclosed; no defect.

Claimed glob characters in a changed path skip its content check. Refuted by a git probe (exact-name match first, listing must equal changed_paths) and by security-reviewer; hardened anyway with --literal-pathspecs and a per-file hunk coverage check.
The tag lookup now also returns None on OSError and UnicodeDecodeError, matching its fail-closed docstring, with tests.
